newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HORSE RACING-AUSTRALIAN JOCKEY SWITCHES MOUNTS IN MID-RACE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-AUSTRALIAN JOCKEY SWITCHES MOUNTS IN MID-RACE.

text.p: An Australian jockey began a race on one horse but finished it in the saddle of another after a bizarre collision on the home turn.
Apprentice Andrew Payne, 17, started the Christmas Handicap at Caulfield race track aboard Hon Kwok Star and was near the rear of the field when another horse, Cogitate, stumbled next to him.
Cogitate's jockey, Payne's brother-in-law Jason Patton, was thrown from the saddle, causing Hon Kwok Star to lose balance.
Thrown sideways in his saddle, Payne found his arm across Cogitate and pulled himself aboard to safely finish the race well down the field as his brother-in-law lay dazed but uninjured on the turf.
"When I looked up and saw where I was I couldn't believe it," Payne said.
"My horse...shifted out really quickly and I fell out the side. My hands landed on the other saddle and I just pulled myself up.
